status: frozen before any multi-seed training run
purpose: measure how much results vary between training seeds, and test whether the earlier single-seed findings hold
informed_by: single-seed results under configs/protocol_first_evaluation.json and configs/protocol_follow_up.json
the exploration results, which set the 50000-update budget
seed_note: seed 1 repeats the settings of the earlier single-seed models
checkpoint_rule_note: each model is evaluated at its final checkpoint; no checkpoint is selected after training

comparisons.question: does the label shift help at the short budget?
does the label shift help at the long budget?

analysis.unit: successes out of 50 final states, per trained model
analysis.pairing: models sharing a training seed are compared with each other
reported: mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum per condition
per-seed differences and an exact sign test per comparison
analysis.limits: with 5 seeds the smallest two-sided sign-test p-value is 0.0625; results are reported whatever they show

rollout.non_finite_action: recorded as a policy failure; the trial is kept
rollout.infrastructure_exception: evaluation marked incomplete; the same initial state is retried after the fix and the retry is recorded

revisions.change: files and folders renamed for readability (artifacts/1_first_evaluation, 2_diagnosis, 3_follow_up, 4_multi_seed; protocol and config names by purpose); no rule, seed, threshold or setting changed
